extends the habits package, its validation, the habit_targets writer and the change_seq helper
reads the caller's habit and its habit_targets rows through the habit lookup
looks up the caller's habit, its date range and archived flag, and bumps change_seq
overlapping write sets: tables completions, users
hooks nudge creation and rewrite into every successful check-in write, including batch items
a nudge's kind and message come from the habit's computed progress
home embeds each habit's progress body
lists and dismisses the nudges the engine writes, and sends clear pushes through its PushSender path
returns habit updates and soft-delete tombstones in the habit response shape
returns check-ins in their response shape
returns nudges, including dismissals, in the nudge response shape

auto_edits.detail: account and habits-core write the same tables habit_targets, habits, users: habits-core runs after account
habits-edit and completions write the same tables completions, users: completions runs after habits-edit

level_gate: after the level's passed nodes are merged, the full gate on the merged tip shows no check failing that did not fail on the last good tip; only then does the target branch move
